amniophysi.name: Amniophysi
amniophysi.description: These fish hatch out of translucent pods formed in caverns below the Infested landscape. They hover to feed.

aquapulmo.name: Aquapulmo
aquapulmo.description: These fish were purposefully contaminated with the Infestation as an Entrati 'experiment'. They feed off the organic deposits in cave systems.
